narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Make the biggest two digit number first, so the answer is fifty three times two.
<bookmark mark='test'/>That gives one hundred six. But fifty two times three already gives one hundred fifty six.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The smallest digit was left to do the multiplying, so the answer stayed small.
